30409.d: The Kingdom of Zanaris is Gielinor's moon.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The quest Lost City is required for any and all methods of accessing Zanaris.
• Skill portal tuned to the Zanaris fairy ring (requires completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift).
• Grace of the elves teleport, with a tuned Max Guild portal (requires completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift).
• Enter the hut in Lumbridge Swamp while holding a Dramen staff or lunar staff.
• Enter any fairy ring after partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen. Requires a Dramen staff, lunar staff, or completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.
• Cosmic altar teleport to the cosmic altar after completing The Lost City.
• Slayer cape perk teleport to Chaeldar.

30424.d: Zaros (pronounced IPAc-en | ' | z | a: | . | r | Q | s respell | ZAH | ross ) is a god associated with fate and control who once saw much of Gielinor as his dominion during the Second Age.

30425.d: A Zaros painting can be found at the tier 3 Chapel in Fort Forinthry.
30425.ex: An artist's interpretation of the Empty Lord.

30426.d: The Zaros altar may be located on the floor 3 of the White Knights' Castle if an ancient hymnal is used on the backside of the Saradomin altar.
30426.ex: Shrine to the glory of Zaros.
